transcript.text: We pay commissions.
>> The higher our LTV goes, the higher the
CAC will be.
>> How do I escape that?
>> So that that's only true if you have a
percentage-based commission on a sale. A
big function of that is what level of
training already exists within the
business and how much of a process is
there. On one extreme, you have
something where someone has to come in
with a ton of skills, a ton of
experience, and there's almost no
structure. Well, that person I've got to
pay a lot of money to do the sale. Now,
if someone comes into an absolute
machine, I can get them closing within
20% of the top guys because what skill
is required to bring someone off the
street? Not a lot. If I can make the
process so easy anyone can do it, which
means that I can pay anyone to do it,
but then I get really good people on a
really good process, and then just
murders.
